title: Null Totem
description: Ever wanted Null from The Broken Script as a Totem? Well this Resourcepack is for you!
body:
Have you ever wanted your totem to be like the Famous Creepy Pasta and Entity from The Broken Script? Well this Resourcepack is for you!

NOTE: THIS IS A FANMADE RESOURCEPACK FOR THE TOTEM IN THE FORM OF Null from TBS (The Broken Script)
